description: Record your verdict on files you reviewed, bound to the SHA-256 of each file as it is now. Call it after every review, audit or approval. If any of the files change later, the verdict stops counting and the CI gate refuses until it is re-checked. Use fail or blocked honestly: a verdict is a record, not a formality.

against.description: Files you checked them against, such as a spec or checklist.

by.description: Your role, for example security-reviewer or code-reviewer.

checks.description: Checks you ran and their exit codes. A claim: a passing verdict with a non-zero check is refused.

harness.description: The tool you run in, for example codex, claude-code or cursor.

model.description: The model you are running as.

note.description: One or two sentences on what you checked.

subjects.description: Repository-relative paths of every file the verdict covers. Only files you actually read.

verdict.description: pass or cleared if the files are fine, fail or blocked if not.

name: slipmark_attest
title: Record a verdict with Slipmark
